messages:
lucy_support: heads up — customer reports that when they added a second promo in the customer portal it replaced the first one instead of stacking. they lost ~$120 in expected credits.
omar_billing: account id?
lucy_support: acct_01F9X2A — i pasted the portal screenshot and the api response the customer pasted below. they say they first applied PROMO50 via API and then added SPRING20 in the portal.
lucy_support: "API response after first apply (what they ran):
```
POST /v1/accounts/acct_01F9X2A/promos
body: { code: \"PROMO50\" }
200 OK
{ applied: [ { code: \"PROMO50\", credits: 100 } ] }
```"
lucy_support: "Then they opened the billing portal and added SPRING20. Portal UI shows only SPRING20 and credits decreased to 20 instead of 120. They attached screenshot: https://files.redwood/test/screenshot123.png"
promo_bot: automatic-log: promo_apply event: acct=acct_01F9X2A codes=[PROMO50] ts=1998765435
promo_bot: automatic-log: promo_apply event: acct=acct_01F9X2A codes=[SPRING20] ts=1998765480
devon_engineer: can you confirm whether the portal calls the same /promos endpoint or a different legacy route? if different, might be a replace semantics.
lucy_support: @devon_engineer it looks like the portal calls /v1/portal/promos/apply per the network trace the customer shared. response: `{ status: \"ok\", active_promos: [\"SPRING20\"] }` (so portal shows only the new one)
devon_engineer: hmm. quick theory: portal apply flow might be using an upsert that overwrites active_promos instead of appending. another possibility is a race with the API: if PROMO50 was still pending activation when SPRING20 applied, the portal flow could have set a new array.
mike_ops: regardless, customer is missing credits. can billing grant 100 credits now and we open an internal bug? i can issue manual credit grant if you confirm.
omar_billing: i can grant provisional credits but need a short justification string and who signs off. lucy, confirm exact missing amount and whether they already consumed any tokens.
lucy_support: they report unused credits. missing = 100. justification: portal overwrote existing promo when applying SPRING20. please tag as temporary grant pending root cause.
omar_billing: ok provisioning +100 credit to acct_01F9X2A now. txn_ref: bill-1998765522
lucy_support: thanks. passing update to customer. i also opened a repro ticket with steps:
- create new account (or use acct_01F9X2A)
- apply PROMO50 via API: POST /v1/accounts/:id/promos { code: PROMO50 }
- immediately open portal and apply SPRING20 via UI
- observe portal UI and /v1/accounts/:id/promos GET
devon_engineer: nice repro. i'll try to run this locally and instrument the portal apply handler. quick DB query to check for destructive update:
```
SELECT id, account_id, active_promos, updated_at FROM promo_allocations WHERE account_id='acct_01F9X2A' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5;
```
devon_engineer: if we see the active_promos replaced at the second timestamp then it's likely the portal write path is doing an assignment instead of union.
promo_bot: audit: db_change detected for acct_01F9X2A updated_at=1998765481 diff: active_promos: [\"PROMO50\"] -> [\"SPRING20\"]
devon_engineer: confirmed in staging repro: portal route uses `UPDATE promo_allocations SET active_promos = $1` rather than `array_cat`/merge. will prepare a fix to change to append behaviour and add a guard if a promo with non-stackable flag is applied.
mike_ops: estimate for patch + deploy? devon?
devon_engineer: small patch, add unit + integration tests, deploy to canary today — 2-3h. need a follow-up migration/backfill script to restore any overwritten entries older than X days; i'll author a query to reconcile via audit logs.
omar_billing: once fix is validated, we'll reconcile impacted accounts retroactively if they didn't spend credits. please collect list.
lucy_support: i'll add this thread to the bug and include customer contact. replying to customer now with provisional grant and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:
promo_bot: ticket created: BUG-4321 portal-promo-overwrite. link: https://jira.redwood/browse/BUG-4321
lucy_support: marking this resolved for now from support side — will reopen if customer says otherwise. cc @devon_engineer @omar_billing :eyes:
notes: repro + provisional grant + engineering fix planned
